messages.FlexibleContactSorting.Name: Flexible Contact Sorting
messages.FlexibleContactSorting.Description: This mod allows sorting contacts flexibly and to your liking, including pinning your favorites to the top. It also adds other Quality of Life features to the Contacts Page, such as a clear button for the search, an extra color for your outgoing conctact requests, capacity display to contacts' sessions, and contacts loading without lag.
messages.FlexibleContactSorting.ClearContactsSear: Adds a clear button to the searchbar on the contacts tab.
messages.FlexibleContactSorting.ExtraContactColor: Adds yellow coloring to outgoing contact requests.
messages.FlexibleContactSorting.FlexibleContactSo: Sorts the contacts list based on the Contact Sorting settings.
messages.FlexibleContactSorting.LagFreeContactsLo: Loads and applies updates to the contacts lists in blocks so the game doesn't freeze.
messages.FlexibleContactSorting.SessionUserCapaci: Indicates the maximum user capacity on sessions that contacts are in and / or color it based on the currently used capacity. For this, the Session Capacity settings are used.
